method: Producer labels withheld. Five distinct positive original pages independently opened through web retrieval; one checkpoint-2 original-source audit reused with saved HTML inspection. All six summaries measured at 25–45 words. Twelve negatives each received one bounded query; three useful candidates were opened to distinguish criticism from profiles. Repeated page opens retrieved relevant article text, not extra sources. Original URL/byline/date, identity and release/live scope checked. No token counts exposed or inferred.
coverageLimits: Pass on a negative means no qualifying review found within this bounded audit; it does not prove no review exists. Review originality and identity remain prerequisites for recovery. No whole-batch factual-failure expansion triggered.
